artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A = \mathbb{C}[x_1,\ldots,x_n,y_1,\ldots,y_n]$ be the polynomial ring in $2n$ variables. Let the symmetric group $S_n$ act on $A$ diagonally by simultaneously permuting the two sets of variables: for $w \in S_n$ and $f \in A$,
$$(w\cdot f)(x_1,\ldots,x_n,y_1,\ldots,y_n) = f(x_{w(1)},\ldots,x_{w(n)},y_{w(1)},\ldots,y_{w(n)}).$$
Let $I \subset A$ be the ideal generated by all $S_n$-invariant polynomials of strictly positive degree, that is, $I = \langle f \in A : w\cdot f = f \text{ for all } w \in S_n,\ f(0)=0\rangle$. The quotient $A/I$ inherits an $S_n$-action; let its sign-isotypic component be
$$(A/I)^{\mathrm{sgn}} = \{\,\overline{f} \in A/I : w\cdot \overline{f} = \mathrm{sgn}(w)\,\overline{f}\ \text{ for all } w \in S_n\,\}.$$
Prove that
$$\dim_{\mathbb{C}} (A/I)^{\mathrm{sgn}} = C_n = \frac{1}{n+1}\binom{2n}{n},$$
the $n$-th Catalan number.
artifact.status_search_result: This is the "Catalan sign" statement for the diagonal coinvariant ring of $S_n$, conjectured by Haiman (1994) as part of his $n!$ and $(n+1)^{n-1}$ conjectures on diagonal coinvariants. The dimension of the sign isotypic component being the Catalan number $C_n$ was proved by Mark Haiman via his work on the Hilbert scheme of points in the plane and the $n!$ theorem (J. Amer. Math. Soc. 2001/2002). It is now a well-known theorem; the q,t-refinement is the q,t-Catalan number.

status_evidence.title: Combinatorics, Symmetric Functions, and Hilbert Schemes (Haiman)
status_evidence.snippet: Haiman proves that the diagonal coinvariant ring has dimension (n+1)^{n-1} and that the alternating (sign) component has dimension equal to the Catalan number C_n.
status_evidence.claim: Haiman proved that the sign-isotypic component of the diagonal coinvariant ring has dimension C_n.

status_evidence.title: The q,t-Catalan Numbers and the Space of Diagonal Harmonics (Haglund)
status_evidence.snippet: The space of diagonal harmonics has its alternating component of dimension equal to the Catalan number, with q,t-graded Hilbert series the q,t-Catalan polynomial.
status_evidence.claim: The Catalan-sign result is established and forms the basis of q,t-Catalan theory.

status_evidence.title: A basis of the alternating diagonal coinvariants
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work giving explicit bases for the alternating component of dimension C_n in the diagonal coinvariant ring.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent research builds on the established theorem dim (A/I)^sgn = C_n.
